what_makes_it_special: Knowledge IS the progression; the only thing the player gains is understanding.

mechanical_innovations.name: Time-loop ship log
mechanical_innovations.description: Solar-system-scale state resets every 22 minutes; clues persist as a shipboard knowledge graph.
mechanical_innovations.impact: Discovery feels like detective work, not item collection.

design_lessons_applicable: A diegetic map of clues outperforms a quest log.
Resetting world state is acceptable when player knowledge persists.
